description: Fundamental ideas in differential and integral calculus

limits.definition: The value a function approaches as the input approaches a given value
limits.continuity: f is continuous at a if lim(x→a) f(x) = f(a)

derivatives.definition: Instantaneous rate of change; slope of tangent line at a point

applications.velocity: Derivative of position with respect to time
applications.acceleration: Derivative of velocity; second derivative of position
applications.optimization: Set f'(x) = 0 to find critical points; second derivative test for max/min
applications.related_rates: Find rate of change of one quantity from another

integrals.definite: ∫[a to b] f(x)dx = F(b) - F(a); net signed area
integrals.fundamental_theorem: Connects derivatives and integrals; differentiation and integration are inverse operations

techniques.u_substitution: Reverse chain rule; let u = g(x)

multivariable.partial_derivatives: Derivative with respect to one variable, holding others constant
multivariable.gradient: Vector of all partial derivatives; points in direction of steepest ascent
multivariable.double_integral: ∫∫f(x,y) dA; volume under surface above region

series.convergence: Series converges if sum of terms approaches finite limit

differential_equations.ode: Ordinary Differential Equation; involves function and its derivatives
differential_equations.separable: dy/dx = f(x)g(y); separate variables and integrate
